name: frontend-coverage-open-points
body: Open design points for the plan: (1) manifest-discovery placement — prefer frontend-side (cargo/rust-analyzer decides what a project is, consistent with the existing Go multi-module handling); an orchestrator-side module-walk is the lighter alternative, decision deferred to the plan. (2) scanner.mjs → scanner.ts requires build.rs to gain a compile step (today it only runs npm ci and stages the .mjs); decide the staged artifact layout. (3) JavaScript dynamic code will raise the unresolved ratio — expected and governed by never-fabricate-edges / exactness-no-heuristic, not a regression. (4) Bundled/generated JavaScript is handled by code_type classification, never by exclusion (all-code-included). (5) Both workstreams' new acceptance tests use scratch /tmp repos per no-real-project-test.
